voice.speaker: calypso
voice.caption: Here at the island's edge the tall trees stand — alder and poplar and sky-high fir, long dry, that will ride light on the water. Take the great bronze axe and the adze; here is cloth for a sail and cord to lace her. Build, and I will bring all the rest.

voice.speaker: calypso
voice.caption: Calypso fells, trims, bores, joins, decks, and fences the timbers over four days.

voice.speaker: calypso
voice.caption: Calypso rigs mast, yard, sail, steering oar, and ballast.

voice.speaker: calypso
voice.caption: Calypso bathes and clothes him, loads food and water, and sends a warm wind behind the raft.

keys.beat: Calypso leads Odysseus to tall trees and gives him axe, adze, augers, cloth, and cord.
He fells, trims, bores, joins, decks, and fences the timbers over four days.
He rigs mast, yard, sail, steering oar, and ballast.
Calypso bathes and clothes him, loads food and water, and sends a warm wind behind the raft.
